title: Region-aware routing explainer diagrams and onboarding map visuals
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Create a set of onboarding and quickstart visuals that explain Redwood's region and latency routing behavior for new customers. Deliver high-fidelity explainer diagrams, an interactive map asset (SVG + PNG fallbacks), and annotated product screenshots for the Quickstart doc and release notes. Visuals should communicate how routing policies (latency-first, cost-first, region-preference) influence request routing across hosted/dedicated/private deployments and what fallbacks look like when capacity is constrained.
deliverables: 3 high-fidelity explainer diagrams (latency-first, cost-first, hybrid) in Figma
1 simplified world map SVG with latency heat overlays and interactive states
3 annotated console screenshots showing routing policy setup and per-route latency visualization
1 responsive illustration set for docs (mobile/tablet/desktop) exported as SVG/PNG/WebP
Accessible color palette and tokenized styles in the Figma file
Export-ready assets and a short usage guide for engineering and docs teams
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains a frames for each diagram with componentized elements and export presets
SVG map scales cleanly to 320–1920px and maintains label legibility
PM and Eng have reviewed and marked designs as 'Approved for Engineering' in comments
Docs team can copy screenshots and markup into the Quickstart with no layout fixes >15 minutes
All visuals meet WCAG AA contrast for text and key UI callouts
design_notes: Prefer simplified Mercator projection for recognizability; annotate regions using Redwood region codes (us-west1, eu-central1, apac-east1)
Use three visual tiers: global map (conceptual), regional routing flow (sequence arrows + latencies), console screenshot (practical setup)
Show fallback behavior visually: dashed arrows to fallback model/region and a clear 'degraded' state color
Include a short caption per asset (20–30 words) for docs and release notes
Consider animation frames for the onboarding modal: small pulse on selected region and stepwise arrow reveal
constraints: Keep PNG exports under 150KB for the docs landing page without losing legibility
No external proprietary map libraries in the docs bundle—deliver plain SVG with limited CSS
Screenshots should avoid real customer data; use synthetic examples and the staging cluster
tech_notes: Coordinate with ENG-2810 for the exact naming of regions and latency buckets (10/50/100/200+ ms)
Provide an SVG with separate layers for regions so engineers can toggle overlays in the docs site
Include a JSON metadata file (in attachments) listing exported asset names, dimensions, and recommended alt text
Work with docs to add an interactive small JS demo later—deliver assets in a format that supports simple CSS animation
